comments.text: A used EV isn't such a good idea as people think. Battery degradation, especially after quick charging will absolutely be an issue. I know there are used EV with plenty of life, but you never know when the whole thing just breaks, be it cooling or electronics or just cascade cell failure. And then you're left with a choice to either pump like 10,15 or even 20k into a new pack or scrap the vehicle. EVs are a very specific use case. People buy them new, living in a house with a charger, prefered with solarPV and daily comutes under 50 miles. Its a great second car for grocery runs and short trips. Buying an EV when you live ina city in an apartment, being dependant on street charging... I can't even imagine the headache.
